label: The Glowing Ruins
summary: A ruin on the Ember Road has started to glow again, the way it did in the mage war. The waystation hires you to find out why before the caravans stop coming.
title: The Glowing Ruins
description: Three hundred years after the mage war, the old watchtower at Cinder Ford is lit from within. Caravans are turning back. The waystation keeper can pay, the scholar can explain, and something inside the tower is waiting.

chapterOutlines.title: Cinder Ford
chapterOutlines.outline: Take the job, and cross the ford at dusk to see the glow up close.

chapterOutlines.title: The Tower Stair
chapterOutlines.outline: Climb through rooms the war left behind, and the people who got there first.

chapterOutlines.title: The Heart of the Glow
chapterOutlines.outline: Find what woke the tower, and decide whether to put it back to sleep.

scene.location: The common room of the Cinder Ford waystation
scene.summary: Evening. Through the shutters the old tower on the far bank glows a soft, wrong orange. The keeper puts a purse of silver on your table.

openThreads: Who reached the ruins before you?

npcs.name: Tamsin Reed
npcs.description: Runs Cinder Ford and will lose everything if the caravans stop.
abilities: Knows every caravan master by name

npcs.name: Orrin Fane
npcs.description: Has read everything about the tower and never been inside it.
goals: See the tower’s workings with his own eyes

relationships.label: Employer

relationships.label: Companion
relationships.status: Thrilled to finally have a guide
